captions.detailed: A wall-mounted transfer arm assembly rendered in dark slate grey and black. It features a rectangular backplate with four mounting bolts, a shoulder bracket supporting a horizontal pivot, a tapered first arm link, a dual-block offset elbow joint, a straight second arm link, and a square end plate with mounting holes. The shoulder and elbow joints enable rotational articulation around parallel horizontal axes, while the end plate provides a terminal mounting interface.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a wall-mounted transfer arm using CadQuery. The model should include a stout rectangular backplate, an angled shoulder bracket, a tapered first link, a deep offset elbow knuckle joint, a straight square-profile second link, and a square terminal end plate.
captions.factory: Construct a rigid base backplate using box primitives, adding cylindrical bolt heads at the corners. Build the shoulder bracket using a combination of boxes and a cylinder for the pivot joint. Create the first arm link by lofting or tapering a box section, then attach a dual-block knuckle joint at the elbow. Extend a straight square beam as the second link, and terminate the arm with a thin square plate containing circular bolt cutouts.
